maria.s: Quick experiment thought — combine stochastic early-exit gating (cheap classifier that predicts next-token entropy) with a lightweight speculative decode tier to reduce tail latency on short prompts. thinking ~15-30% p95 cut without big quality loss.
raj_p: Nice. Are you thinking this as an extra step before speculative fetch or inside the speculation loop?
tim: Could also help avoid unnecessary kv-cache work for <64 tokens workloads. cheap gate -> skip heavy model.
maria.s: Proposal: run a tiny binary classifier (FP16 MLP or quantized 4-bit head) after prefix to predict if full decode needed. If low-confidence, route to 1-token speculative model (smaller quantized variant).
cheng_w: How do we benchmark regressions? need clear holdouts and QA metrics. prefer to run on 3 datasets: conv QA, summarization snippets, and short-search queries. keep a fixed seed sweep.
eva: For quantized variants remember weird tokenization edgecases — post-quant + early-exit can amplify hallucination. add a safety checklist.
maria.s: Agreed. Draft eval plan: (1) baseline full model (FP16) (2) quantized 4-bit full model (3) early-exit gate + small model fallback (hybrid) (4) speculative-only baseline. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, extra tokens served, ROUGE/EM on QA, token-level KL to baseline distribution, and human pass/fail rate on small sample.
raj_p: I'd add a "regression alarm" threshold: if EM drops >1.5% absolute OR KL >0.12 on holdout, fail canary.
eva: Also track prefix-dependent bias. gate could systematically drop certain prompt styles. we need stratified analysis by prompt length and domain.
cheng_w: Config example for canary tests (pseudo):
```json
{
  "gate_type": "mlp-32",
  "gate_threshold": 0.6,
  "spec_tier": "13B-int8-lite",
  "fallback_policy": "full-model-on-conflict",
  "batching": "enabled"
}
```
mar ia.s: (typo) maria.s: ^^^ small gate_threshold sweep 0.5,0.6,0.7. Also test temperature coupling (gate trained on temp=0.7 but prod temp=0.2 causes mismatch).
ops-bot: CI note: running small-canary on dedicated pool scheduled for 2026-03-21 03:00 UTC. (queued)
bench-bot: Quick synthetic run summary (short prompts subset, 10k samples): p95 baseline=210ms, p95 hybrid=168ms (-20%), EM delta=-0.8% absolute, KL=0.045. more full runs pending.
tim: Those numbers look promising. next steps: 1) run stratified canary w/ human review on 1k samples, 2) add adversarial prompt set, 3) post-quant calibration of gate.
maria.s: I'll spin up the canary and post a short checklist in #eng-ml once results are live. volunteers to review 150 human samples?
raj_p: I can review.
eva: I'll do the adversarial set.
cheng_w: I'll take calibration + metric dashboards.
maria.s: Thanks team. Keeping notes here — will update thread with links to perf dashboards and canary gist. :thumbsup:
